name: Miletus
line: Miletus was a seaport city in Asia Minor, about 36 miles south of Ephesus, where Paul called the Ephesian elders to meet him.

moments.title: Paul Stops at Miletus
moments.text: Paul has decided to sail past Ephesus because he is in a hurry to reach Jerusalem by Pentecost. His ship comes opposite Chios, then arrives at Samos, and then comes to Miletus.

moments.title: Paul Calls the Elders
moments.text: From Miletus, Paul sends for the elders of the church at Ephesus and reminds them how he served the Lord and taught them. He says he is going to Jerusalem, and the Holy Spirit warns him that chains wait for him.

moments.title: Trophimus Left Sick
moments.text: Paul writes that he left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
